title: The Suno Shelf That Started the Goblin Tract
summary: Founding multimodal artifact: a NULLWORKS Suno library screenshot whose juxtaposition of UEBER DER REUSS, BIG SQUIRTSKEEZE, SUCCESSOR, PACKED IN A BOX, and HARRY PLOPPINS triggered the idea of a living multimedia artifact archive and future coffee-table/digital exploration experience.

observations.body: A future PHRONONAUT should be able to enter through a strange artifact and follow why it exists, who created or covered it, what preceded it, what descended from it, and what apparently unrelated lineages later collided.
The physical coffee-table book is one interface into the archive, not the archive itself. QR/NFC or future interfaces may expose related audio, video, provenance, and graph trails.
